description: Read or explicitly update ONE person’s job-scoped Agent notes — the Markdown document where you keep durable, job-relevant learnings and feedback about this person across proposals, messages, interviews, assessments, contracts, Project To-dos and training (people_table.agent_notes.*). Scoped to organization + job + jobPersonId: the same person on another job or in another organization has another, isolated document; never a global profile, never in talent search, profiles, the candidate dossier or worker surfaces. Behaviour contract: READ before substantive work with this person; UPDATE after a material, durable learning or feedback event — not after every message; keep facts, observations, feedback, open questions and follow-ups distinguishable; attach bounded sourceReferences (proposal, conversation, message, interview, assessment, contract, project_todo, training, manual) that belong to this person on this job; refer to the person by the masked display name or ids only; NEVER store contact details, credentials, government ids, payment data, medical data, protected-class inference, personal speculation or raw message dumps; correct superseded facts instead of accumulating contradictions. action=get returns the full document with version/etag; append adds appendMarkdown at expectedVersion (0 creates); replace rewrites bodyMarkdown at expectedVersion; archive (confirm=true) clears the body and keeps every revision — the only destructive lifecycle, there is no delete; history pages revision metadata (includeContent needs people_table:write). Writes need idempotencyKey (same key + same payload replays; changed payload is a 409) and refuse, with value-free diagnostics, a stale expectedVersion (409 VERSION_MISMATCH), empty/oversized bodies, raw HTML (UNSAFE_MARKDOWN), the person’s full name, surname, e-mail or phone in the body or reason (CONTENT_LEAK: one generic refusal with no line, kind or field, audited hash-only) and foreign source references. Each write that passes every other check spends one attempt of the account’s write budget (10 writes per hour across all jobs, shared by the web and API surfaces; an exact replay or an earlier refusal spends nothing); once it is spent, every write is a 429 RATE_LIMITED until the window moves. Requires people_table:read (get, history) or people_table:write.

appendMarkdown.description: append only. The observation/section to add after the current body; at most 8000 characters after normalization (CRLF → LF, trailing whitespace trimmed).

bodyMarkdown.description: replace only. The whole new document; at most 32000 characters after normalization (CRLF → LF, trailing whitespace trimmed).

confirm.description: archive only. Must be literally true.

expectedVersion.description: append, replace, archive. The version you read (0 for an EMPTY document); a stale value is a 409 VERSION_MISMATCH.

idempotencyKey.description: append, replace, archive. Same key + same payload replays the original outcome; same key + changed payload is a 409.

includeContent.description: history only. Revision bodies; requires people_table:write.

jobPersonId.description: The stable job-person id from the People table (never a name).

sourceReferences.description: append, replace. Bounded references that must belong to this person on this job.

id.description: Always present; null only for manual.

name: opentrain_people_agent_notes
